verses.english: The faculties of pleasure, pain, happiness, sadness, and equanimity.

verses.pali: Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti—
verses.english: A noble disciple comes to truly understand these five faculties’ origin, disappearance, gratification, drawback, and escape.

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
verses.english: Such a noble disciple is called a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.”
